name: Maine Youth Fish & Game Summer Camp
description_short: Outdoor day camp at the association's Pickerel Pond lodge for ages 8 to 15, with daily buses from the Dr. Lewis S. Libby School in Milford. Campers learn fishing, archery, marksmanship, wilderness survival and paddling from camp staff and visiting experts; weeks for ages 12 to 15 include one overnight.
notes: Weeks alternate by age: 12 to 15 in weeks 1 and 4, 8 to 11 in weeks 2 and 3. Camp runs Monday to Friday. The lodge is on Pickerel Pond in Township 32 MD, Hancock County; the association's mailing address is P.O. Box 337, Stillwater (part of Old Town).
